news.headline: Rapid Micro Biosystems to Announce Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results on August 7, 2026
news.summary: Rapid Micro Biosystems said it will report second-quarter 2026 financial results before market open on Friday, August 7, 2026. Management will host a webcast conference call at 8:30 a.m. ET the same day to discuss the results.

news.headline: Rapid Micro Biosystems (RPID) CEO Exercises Stock Options and Boosts Holdings
news.summary: President and CEO Robert G. Spignesi Jr. exercised a fully vested stock option for 1,402 Class A shares at $0.75 per share on July 22, 2026, ahead of the option's August 11, 2026 expiration. No shares were sold in the filing, leaving Spignesi with 1,191,973 directly held shares.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings release and conference call
catalysts.detail: Rapid Micro Biosystems will report second-quarter 2026 financial results before market open on August 7, 2026, followed by a management webcast at 8:30 a.m. ET; investors will be watching for progress against the FY2026 guidance of $37M-$41M revenue and 30-38 Growth Direct system placements.

pulse: Rapid Micro Biosystems continues to grow its Growth Direct automated microbial QC installed base, following a record Q4 2025 and a Q1 2026 with $8.0M revenue (+11% YoY) and reaffirmed FY2026 guidance of $37M-$41M, but the stock trades near its 52-week lows (~$2, market cap roughly $95-100M) after a May 2026 dilutive equity-and-warrant offering and a wider-than-expected Q1 net loss. News flow has been light in the past six weeks, dominated by routine insider-option-exercise filings, with the next major catalyst being the Q2 2026 earnings report on August 7, 2026 that will show whether system-placement and gross-margin momentum is holding up.
